heading: Germany’s Political Shake-Up
excerpt: State election results illustrate Germany’s political fragmentation as the CDU and SPD lose voters to the Greens and AfD.
content:
The CDU and SPD–members of the ruling grand coalition Berlin–have lost voters to the left (the Greens) and right (AfD) on issues ranging from the environment to migration.

This B|Visual displays Germany’s political fragmentation through vote-share differences following recent state-level elections.
